arbre.name: The World Tree Ysmera
arbre.description: An eight-hundred-metre tree whose roots cover seven leagues. The druids say it grows in every world at once.

epave.name: The Wreck of the Leviathan
epave.description: The largest galleon ever built, stranded on the reef for a century. Scavengers still find gold in it, and worse.

citadelle-bastion.name: The Bastion
citadelle-bastion.description: The white citadel that gave the city its name. Its blue-slate towers have never been taken.

arene.name: The Azure Arena
arene.description: A forty-thousand-seat arena hosting the Crown Games.

aerolys.description: A sky city built on a mountain shard torn from the ground. Its ether crystals hold it a thousand metres up.

eparse-1.name: Heron Isle
eparse-1.description: A floating islet of meadows where ether herons nest.

eparse-2.name: Cascade Isle
eparse-2.description: Its springs pour into the void and fall back as rain on the sea.

eparse-3.name: Recluse's Isle
eparse-3.description: A technomancer hermit lives here alone with his automata.

eparse-4.name: Chained Isle
eparse-4.description: Moored to the seabed by three giant chains that no one forged.

eparse-5.name: Varn Isle
eparse-5.description: A peak fragment torn from the Fangs during the Great Upheaval.

coeur-de-braise.name: The Ember-Heart
coeur-de-braise.description: The volcano has been rumbling for three years. Cinderstead's glassblowers read the future in its smoke.

fleche.name: The Ether Spire
fleche.description: A crystal column as tall as a mountain, source of the Wastes' ether. Its light can be seen at night from Kheranne.

wyrm.name: The Wyrm's Bones
wyrm.description: The skeleton of a three-hundred-metre dragon, half buried in the dunes.

phare.name: Corsaille Lighthouse
phare.description: Its rotating light guides ships through the reefs.

portail.name: Portal of the Ancients
portail.description: A circle of monoliths under the ice. Once a century, it opens.

tour-du-guet.name: Watch Tower
tour-du-guet.description: An Aubemont signal tower, halfway between the two continents.
